title: Output of a Goldreich–Levin stage step
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $a,b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$, and let $M\ge1$ be an integer Fourier norm bound. For a Boolean target $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, a stage index $k<n$, a Goldreich–Levin query state, and a finite active family of coordinate subsets, the output of running the stage-step program is the state obtained by appending the stage’s estimate records and applying the prescribed state update.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean target on the sign cube
